# TPC-Havoc Q13_v6

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT order_count, customer_distribution FROM (SELECT c_count AS order_count, COUNT(*) AS customer_distribution FROM (SELECT customer_orders.c_custkey, customer_orders.c_count FROM (SELECT c_custkey, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS c_count FROM customer LEFT OUTER JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey AND NOT o_comment LIKE '%special%requests%' GROUP BY c_custkey) AS customer_orders) AS customer_summary GROUP BY c_count) AS distribution_summary ORDER BY customer_distribution DESC, order_count DESC
```
